title: Vulkanic
body:
# ℹ️Information
This modpack Optimizes minecraft with vulkan rendering engine, for now you can't use shaders with vulkan and some mods are incompatible which you can check in the [Vulkan Discord server](https://discord.gg/FVXg7AYR2Q) and here is some graphs of other mods & vanilla

# ⚙️Mods used
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/g96Z4WVZ)

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/P7dR8mSH)

If you download the modpack thanks and also take a look at my other project Vulkanic+ if you want more QOL features!
